pregame.packet.player_baselines.method: The player's own games in the window (recency-weighted mean; percentiles of his game log), scaled by half of the opponent's allowed-per-game deviation from league average for that position, capped at +/-15%. This is NOT the three-model consensus and has not been validated against prices. Injury replacements, role changes and game script are not applied: the analyst must adjust for them.
